notes.title: RELEASE: "LEGENDS OF SAVVARAH: CHILDREN OF THE SUN"
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

My new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416490/Legends_of_Savvarah_Children_of_the_Sun/]"Legends of Savvarah: Children of the Sun"[/url], has just been released.

It takes place in the world of Savvarah, and the game is fully complete.

You’ll find plenty of choices, multiple endings, and everything else you enjoy.

If you liked (or like) my projects, you can support me by purchasing the game and, of course, leaving a review. :)

notes.title: Release "Legends of Savvarah: Time of Pariah"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/9a5badba55d02ed9c3fb33649c4bef9ab5263b90.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

[b]Legends of Savvarah: Time of Pariah[/b] has been released. You can purchase it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416500/Legends_of_Savvarah_Time_of_Pariah/]HERE[/url].

1. The game is complete. It is not a part or early access.

2. The game takes place in the same world as "Gods of Savvarah," but on a different continent.

3. The story is more down-to-earth and highly variable (24 endings, romantic interests, and more).
